claim.claim-text: 2. The device of claim 1, further comprising an actuating mechanism configured to rotate the elongate body and the snare loop.
3. The device of claim 2, wherein the actuating mechanism is configured to rotate the snare loop independently of the elongate body.
4. The device of claim 2, further comprising at least one detent configured to at least temporarily hold the snare loop in a specified rotational position.

5. The device of claim 1, wherein the tightening element comprises an expanded configuration and a compressed configuration, and wherein the tightening element is configured to decrease the size of the aperture when the tightening element is in the compressed configuration.

6. The device of claim 1, wherein the tightening element comprises an open configuration and a closed configuration, and wherein the tightening element is configured to decrease the size of the aperture when the tightening element is in the open configuration.

7. The device of claim 1, wherein the tightening element comprises a force generator and a lock, wherein the force generator comprises a loop and ends, and wherein the loop at least partially defines the aperture.

8. The device of claim 7, wherein the force generator has a cross-sectional diameter, and wherein the cross-sectional diameter of the force generator decreases when a tensile force is applied to the force generator.

9. The device of claim 7, wherein the tightening element comprises an open configuration in which the loop is configured to encircle a target tissue and the loop and the ends are relaxed, a tensioned-closed configuration in which the loop is configured to apply a closure force to the target tissue and the loop and the ends are tensioned, and a relaxed-closed configuration in which the loop is configured to apply a closure force to the target tissue, the loop is tensioned, and the ends are relaxed.

10. The device of claim 9, wherein the lock comprises a lumen therethrough, and wherein the lumen comprises a narrow region configured to prevent the force generator from moving through the lumen when the tightening element is in the open configuration and the relaxed-closed configuration.
11. The device of claim 9, wherein the tightening element is configured to move from the open configuration to the tensioned-closed configuration when the lock is advanced distally.

12. The device of claim 9, wherein a cross-sectional diameter of the ends of the force generator is greater than a cross-sectional diameter of the loop of the force generator when the tightening element is in the relaxed-closed configuration.

13. The device of claim 7, wherein the lock comprises a lumen therethrough, and wherein the lumen comprises a narrow region configured to prevent the force generator from moving through the lumen when the tightening element is relaxed.
14. The device of claim 13, wherein the narrow region comprises a cylindrical portion and a conical portion that form a ledge.

15. The device of claim 7, further comprising a pusher slidably disposed in the elongate body and configured to move the lock, wherein the pusher is configured to advance the lock distally along the first and second ends of the tightening element.
